resume_context: Nadine Beckwith is a full-stack Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience at Amazon (6 years, 2 roles), Chewy (3 years), and Federated Investors (3 years). Currently doing part-time upholstery work while seeking return to engineering. Education: IT degree from Point Park University, History degree from Cal U of PA. Strongest in frontend (React/TypeScript/JavaScript — proven track record) with growing backend skills (Spring Boot — recent enjoyment, slightly less depth). Open to SDE1/SDE2/mid-level roles — not career climbing, optimizing for stability and psychological safety. At Chewy: built event-driven pipelines (S3/Lambda/Terraform), migrated Vertica to Snowflake, led zero-downtime RDS migrations, owned React/TS UI components, designed org-based access control, supported robotics launch (<0.1% defect rate), led shared component patterns. At Amazon (SDE II): designed data viz apps in metrics platform, led COVID-19 dashboard (delivered in 2 weeks), worked with international legal on privacy, mentored L4 to L5. At Amazon (Program Developer): defect monitoring dashboards, productivity tracking tools. At Federated Investors: SSRS/VBA reporting in regulated environment, automated batch workflows, SEC compliance. Strengths: execution, triage/incident response, collaboration, independent ticket execution, honest about gaps. Known gaps: deep infrastructure/platform engineering, not a deep backend expert yet. Best fit: Java/Spring-based full-stack shops, React/TypeScript frontend roles, calm process-oriented teams with structured onboarding, 100-1000 employee companies.
